Part 1 高频 物品 OBJECTS

Childhood activities

童年活动

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1What were your favourite activities?

My favourite activities as a kid were playing tag and hide and seek with my friends, and also computer games. We'd run around the neighbourhood until it got dark, then head home to play games on the computer.

童年最爱抓人游戏、捉迷藏和打电脑游戏。

Q2What were your favourite activities when you were a child?

When I was a child, I loved outdoor games with my friends, like tag and hide and seek, and I was also hooked on computer games. Back then, any free moment after school felt like a chance to have fun.

小时候爱和伙伴玩户外游戏，也迷电脑游戏。

Q3Did you prefer to do activities alone or with a group of people when you were a child?

With a group, definitely. I was happiest when I was playing tag or hide and seek with my friends, since everything felt more fun together. Doing things alone never really appealed to me as a kid. I loved the company.

小时候喜欢跟一群小伙伴玩，有人陪才开心。

Q4Are there any differences between the activities you liked when you were a child and those you like now?

Yes, quite a few. As a child I loved group activities with my friends, but now I mostly enjoy things alone, like chatting with AI or watching videos on my computer. I guess my hobbies have become much more solitary.

有变化，小时候爱群体活动，现在更喜欢一个人，比如跟AI聊天。
